expression: winsorize(add(zscore(add(ts_av_diff(divide(subtract(high, low), close), 20), ts_av_diff(divide(subtract(high, low), close), 5))), multiply(0.5, zscore(divide(subtract(add(high, low), multiply(2, close)), subtract(high, low))))), std=4)
economic_rationale: Two orthogonal intraday-microstructure signals on delay-0 USA TOP3000. Term 1 (primary): multi-horizon intraday RANGE EXPANSION, ts_av_diff of (high-low)/close over 5d and 20d -- today's true range relative to its own recent average proxies information arrival / heightened investor attention, which exhibits short-horizon cross-sectional continuation. Term 2 (0.5 weight): intraday CLOSE POSITION (high+low-2*close)/(high-low), positive when the close sits in the lower half of the day's range (a weak / oversold close), capturing a short-term reversal bounce. Buy stocks whose range is expanding AND closed weak; short expanding-range stocks that closed strong. The range term conditions the reversal on days of genuine information flow, which is why the two diversify (drawdown collapses from ~0.22 to ~0.09) and Sharpe rises above the delay-0 2.0 bar.
niche_operator: ts_av_diff (deviation from trailing mean; uncommon vs ts_mean/ts_delta)
